description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to Land Parcel of Nedimala, Dehiwala D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520813 & Seventeen Other Land Parcels
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of notices calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act, dealing specifically with land ownership, possession, and interest determinations. It involves land registrations, title settlements, and property ownership matters across multiple districts, which falls squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
